rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); canvas-kernel: register_font_file now sends a file that starts with the WOFF2 magic through the existing register_font_woff2 path, which decompresses and validates it, instead of handing the compressed bytes to the platform font manager, and woff2_file_routes() counts those routes so the path is observable. Imported designs name captured @font-face files by path and pages often serve WOFF2; CoreText decodes WOFF2 itself, but a FreeType build without Brotli does not, so every platform now reads the file the same way. Every other file still goes to register_font unchanged. No authority boundary moves; the decoder is the one already compiled into pulp-canvas. Vellum inherits the WOFF2 file route with the canvas kernel.
tests: pulp-test-font-woff2 "a WOFF2 font file registers through the file path"
